inputs.description: consumed input version table; present only for proof-producing rules (sole source of proof.inputs). Absent for no-proof rules (triage).

params.description: recorded declared params per rules.RULES[rule].params, e.g. {"sim_run": 5} for triage

caused_by.description: the failures this dispatch answers, as [rule, run] pairs; present iff this is a rework. The route decision reads the failing stage_specific off disk, which moves, so the coordinates are recorded rather than re-derived.
